item.lead:
The corpus is 1,115,394 characters long, and the script wants the first ninety percent for learning. Ninety percent of that is not a whole number, so the cut has to land on an integer.

Run the cells to do the arithmetic yourself. Watch what happens to the fraction, then check that the two pieces add back to the whole. The numbers should match the recorded comments: 1,003,854 and 111,540.
item.follow: You saw the cut land on 1,003,854, with 111,540 left over and nothing lost or counted twice. Next: why that last tenth must never be seen during training.
